name: Past Tenses
description: Past Simple, Past Continuous, Past Perfect and Past Perfect Continuous: irregular verbs, narrative sequencing, used to and would.

passages.title: A Letter That Arrived Sixty Years Late
passages.content:
In 2019 a postman in a small Welsh town (1) ______ an envelope that looked very different from the rest of the morning's post. The paper was yellow, and the stamp was one that (2) ______ out of use for more than fifty years.

The letter (3) ______ in 1958 by a young soldier to his mother. For reasons nobody could explain, it (4) ______ behind a sorting machine ever since. By the time it was found, the soldier's mother had died, but his younger sister still lived in the same street.

She (5) ______ the letter at her kitchen table when a local reporter knocked on the door to ask whether it was true.

passages.title: The Lost Umbrella
passages.content:
Last Tuesday it (1) ______ heavily all morning. On the way to school, Ivan (2) ______ his umbrella on the bus.

He (3) ______ that it was missing until he (4) ______ at the school gate, soaked to the skin. Luckily, the driver (5) ______ it to the lost property office the same afternoon.

passages.title: A Power Cut in the Middle of a Match
passages.content:
We (1) ______ the final of the school volleyball tournament when all the lights in the gym suddenly (2) ______ off. Nobody could see a thing.

By the time the caretaker (3) ______ the problem, the players (4) ______ in the dark for almost twenty minutes. When the lights came back on, we (5) ______ that half of the audience had quietly gone home.

passages.title: The Mystery of the Painted Door
passages.content:
For years nobody in our street knew who (1) ______ the old door of the bakery with sunflowers. The owner insisted that she (2) ______ it one morning in 2015 already decorated.

It was only last spring, while builders (3) ______ the wall next to it, that they found a signed sketch inside. The artist, a retired teacher, admitted that she (4) ______ the design for weeks before she finally (5) ______ up the courage to paint it at night.

questions.title: We ___ to the coast last August and stayed there for a fortnight.
questions.explanation: «Last August» — завершений час у минулому, тому Past Simple; «drive» має неправильну форму «drove».

questions.title: While I ___ dinner, the doorbell rang twice.
questions.explanation: Довга дія-фон у Past Continuous переривається короткою в Past Simple.

questions.title: What is the past simple form of the verb 'buy'?
questions.explanation: «Buy» — неправильне дієслово: buy — bought — bought.

questions.title: They ___ the film because they had already seen it.
questions.explanation: Заперечення в Past Simple утворюють через «didn't» + перша форма дієслова.

questions.title: Choose the correct question: Where ___ you last night?
questions.explanation: Питання про місце перебування з «you» вимагає форми «were».

questions.title: When we arrived at the stadium, the match ___ already.
questions.explanation: Матч почався раніше за прибуття, тому попередня дія стоїть у Past Perfect.

questions.title: I ___ play the violin when I was a child, but I gave it up.
questions.explanation: «Used to» описує колишню звичку, якої більше немає.

questions.title: Which past simple sentence is correct?
options: She didn't go to the party.
She didn't went to the party.
She not went to the party.
She wasn't go to the party.
questions.explanation: Після «didn't» уживають першу форму дієслова.

questions.title: The children ___ in the garden all afternoon yesterday.
questions.explanation: «All afternoon yesterday» вказує на тривалу дію в минулому — Past Continuous.

questions.title: Which of these is an irregular past form?
questions.explanation: «Teach» — неправильне дієслово: teach — taught — taught.

questions.title: He ___ his homework before his friends called him out.
questions.explanation: Домашнє завдання зроблено раніше за дзвінок друзів — Past Perfect.

questions.title: Which time expression normally goes with the Past Simple?
questions.explanation: «Ago» завжди вживається з Past Simple.

questions.title: It ___ heavily when the plane took off.
questions.explanation: Сніг ішов як фон у момент злету — Past Continuous.

questions.title: How do we form the negative of the Past Continuous?
options: was or were plus not plus the -ing form
questions.explanation: Заперечення Past Continuous утворюють через was/were + not + -ing.

questions.title: Match each irregular verb with its past simple form.
questions.explanation: Форми неправильних дієслів треба знати напам'ять.

questions.title: Match each past tense with a sentence that illustrates it.
pairs: We visited the museum on Friday.
We were visiting the museum when it closed.
We had visited the museum before lunch.
We had been visiting museums all week.
questions.explanation: Кожен час минулого має свою функцію в розповіді.

questions.title: Match each sentence half with the ending that completes it.
pairs: After she had read the report,
questions.explanation: Сполучник підказує, який час потрібен у другій частині.

questions.title: Match each past form with the function it usually performs in a story.
pairs: a completed event in a story
an earlier event looked back on
a step further into the past
a former habit no longer true
questions.explanation: У розповіді кожен час виконує свою роль: події, фон, передісторія, звичка.

questions.title: By the time the guests arrived, my mother ___ for six hours.
questions.explanation: «For six hours» до моменту в минулому — Past Perfect Continuous.

questions.title: Which sentence correctly shows that one action interrupted another?
options: I was crossing the road when a cyclist shouted at me.
I crossed the road when a cyclist was shouting at me.
I had crossed the road when a cyclist shouted at me.
I had been crossing the road when a cyclist shouted.
questions.explanation: Довга дія в Past Continuous переривається короткою в Past Simple.

questions.title: She was exhausted because she ___ all night.
questions.explanation: Утома — наслідок тривалої попередньої дії, тому Past Perfect Continuous.

questions.title: Which sentence about past time contains a mistake?
options: I didn't knew about the meeting.
I didn't know about the meeting.
I hadn't known about the meeting.
I wasn't told about the meeting.
questions.explanation: Після «didn't» уживають першу форму: «didn't know».

questions.title: Every summer we ___ spend a fortnight at my grandmother's cottage.
questions.explanation: «Would» описує повторювані дії в минулому; зі станами його не вживають.

questions.title: Which sentence means that he no longer smokes?
options: He used to smoke a lot.
He is used to smoking a lot.
He got used to smoking a lot.
questions.explanation: «Used to» означає, що дія була в минулому, але припинилася.

questions.title: The road was wet because it ___ during the night.
questions.explanation: Дощ ішов раніше, а мокра дорога — наслідок, тому Past Perfect.

questions.title: I did not recognise her at first because she ___ her hair.
questions.explanation: Вона пофарбувала волосся раніше за момент зустрічі — Past Perfect.

questions.title: Which sentence places the two events in the correct order?
options: The train had left before we reached the platform.
The train left before we had reached the platform.
The train was leaving before we had reached the platform.
The train has left before we reached the platform.
questions.explanation: Потяг поїхав першим, тому саме ця дія стоїть у Past Perfect.

questions.title: He kept apologising, although nobody ___ him.
questions.explanation: Ніхто не звинувачував ще до того, як він вибачався, — Past Perfect.

questions.title: Which sentence uses 'would' correctly for a past habit?
options: My father would tell us stories every evening.
My father would be a teacher for years.
My father would have a large library.
My father would know the answer at once.
questions.explanation: «Would» правильно вживати для повторюваних дій, а не станів.

questions.title: What is the difference between 'I was used to getting up early' and 'I used to get up early'?
options: The first means it felt normal; the second means it was a former habit.
The first means a former habit; the second means it felt normal.
There is no difference in meaning.
The first refers to the present and the second to the past.
questions.explanation: «Be used to» означає «звик», «used to» — колишню звичку.

questions.title: The lecture had already begun by the time we ___ the hall.
questions.explanation: Перша дія вже в Past Perfect, тому друга стоїть у Past Simple.

questions.title: Match each sentence with the exact meaning it conveys.
pairs: When I arrived, they had eaten.
they started eating at that point
When I arrived, they were eating.
When I arrived, they had been eating for an hour.
the meal had lasted a long time
questions.explanation: Час дієслова точно визначає, у якому порядку відбулися події.

questions.title: Match each narrative purpose with the past form that expresses it.
pairs: a scene at the start of a narrative
was or were plus the -ing form
the cause of a past situation
the events of a completed trip
questions.explanation: Вибір часу залежить від того, що саме автор хоче показати в розповіді.

questions.title: Match each faulty past-tense sentence with the reason it is wrong.
pairs: I have visited Rome last year.
a finished time marker with a perfect form
a state verb used in the continuous
an infinitive is required after did
the earlier event needs a past form
questions.explanation: Кожна помилка має свою причину: невідповідний маркер, стан у Continuous, форма після «did».

questions.title: Match each verb with the past participle used in perfect forms.
questions.explanation: Третя форма неправильних дієслів потрібна для перфектних часів і пасиву.

questions.title: Match each sentence with the aspect the speaker chooses to highlight.
pairs: She had been writing for hours.
She wrote six pages on Monday.
a finished event at a stated time
She was writing when I called.
an activity in progress at a past moment
questions.explanation: Perfect показує обсяг зробленого, Perfect Continuous — тривалість.

questions.title: Rarely ___ such a badly organised event.
questions.explanation: Після «rarely» на початку речення відбувається інверсія: допоміжне перед підметом.

questions.title: No sooner ___ the announcement than the hall fell silent.
questions.explanation: Конструкція «no sooner … than» вимагає інверсії та Past Perfect.

questions.title: It was not until the following spring that the committee ___ its final decision.
questions.explanation: У конструкції «It was not until … that» головне дієслово стоїть у Past Simple.

questions.title: Which sentence is the most natural in a formal historical account?
options: By 1918 the empire had already collapsed.
By 1918 the empire has already collapsed.
By 1918 the empire was already collapsing away.
questions.explanation: Past Perfect із «by 1918» точно показує, що подія відбулася раніше за вказаний момент.

questions.title: Which sentence expresses regret about a past habit?
options: I wish I hadn't spent so much time on social media.
I wish I didn't spend so much time on social media then.
I wish I don't spend so much time on social media.
I wish I wasn't spending so much time on it then.
questions.explanation: «I wish» + Past Perfect виражає жаль про минуле.

questions.title: Hardly ___ the door when the telephone started ringing.
questions.explanation: Після «hardly» на початку речення потрібна інверсія й Past Perfect.

questions.title: Match each inverted structure with its correct completion.
pairs: No sooner had we sat down
Only after the storm did they
questions.explanation: Кожна інверсійна конструкція має свій сталий сполучник продовження.

questions.title: Match each sentence with the writer's narrative purpose.
pairs: Snow was falling steadily over the empty square.
He turned the key and pushed the door open.
They had been arguing for weeks.
questions.explanation: Вибір часу підказує читачеві, що це — фон, дія чи передісторія.

questions.title: Match each formal past structure with its plain equivalent.
pairs: They did not know at all
It was then that he confessed
Never before had she felt so calm
She had never felt so calm before
questions.explanation: Формальні інверсійні конструкції мають прості відповідники зі звичайним порядком слів.

questions.title: A Letter That Arrived Sixty Years Late — gap 1
questions.explanation: Одна завершена дія в конкретний момент минулого (in 2019) — Past Simple. Present Perfect не поєднується з указаним роком.

questions.title: A Letter That Arrived Sixty Years Late — gap 2
questions.explanation: Марка вийшла з ужитку задовго до 2019 року й залишалася такою аж до моменту знахідки: дія, що тривала до іншої минулої події, — Past Perfect (had been … for more than fifty years).

questions.title: A Letter That Arrived Sixty Years Late — gap 3
questions.explanation: Лист не писав сам себе — потрібен пасив, а рік 1958 вимагає минулого часу: was written by a young soldier.

questions.title: A Letter That Arrived Sixty Years Late — gap 4
questions.explanation: Ever since у розповіді про минуле означає «від того часу аж до моменту знахідки» — Past Perfect Continuous: had been lying.

questions.title: A Letter That Arrived Sixty Years Late — gap 5
questions.explanation: Тривала дія, яку перервала інша (when a reporter knocked), — Past Continuous: was reading.

questions.title: The Lost Umbrella — gap 1
questions.explanation: Last Tuesday — завершений відрізок у минулому: Past Simple.

questions.title: The Lost Umbrella — gap 2
questions.explanation: Одна завершена дія в минулому — Past Simple неправильного дієслова leave.

questions.title: The Lost Umbrella — gap 3
questions.explanation: Розповідь про минуле, заперечення в Past Simple: didn't notice.

questions.title: The Lost Umbrella — gap 4
questions.explanation: Until he arrived — послідовна завершена дія в минулому: Past Simple.

questions.title: The Lost Umbrella — gap 5
questions.explanation: The same afternoon — одна завершена дія: Past Simple від take.

questions.title: A Power Cut in the Middle of a Match — gap 1
questions.explanation: Тривала дія, яку перервала інша (when the lights went off): Past Continuous.

questions.title: A Power Cut in the Middle of a Match — gap 2
questions.explanation: Раптова коротка дія, що перервала тривалу, — Past Simple.

questions.title: A Power Cut in the Middle of a Match — gap 3
questions.explanation: Після by the time у минулому вживається Past Simple; пасив не підходить, бо лагодить сам сторож.

questions.title: A Power Cut in the Middle of a Match — gap 4
questions.explanation: For almost twenty minutes до іншої минулої події — Past Perfect Continuous.

questions.title: A Power Cut in the Middle of a Match — gap 5
questions.explanation: Дія одразу після when the lights came back on — Past Simple; see у тривалому часі тут не вживається.

questions.title: The Mystery of the Painted Door — gap 1
questions.explanation: Розфарбували двері раніше, ніж люди про це «не знали», — Past Perfect.

questions.title: The Mystery of the Painted Door — gap 2
questions.explanation: Непряма мова після insisted зсуває час на крок назад: Past Perfect.

questions.title: The Mystery of the Painted Door — gap 3
questions.explanation: While — тло, на якому сталася інша подія: Past Continuous.

questions.title: The Mystery of the Painted Door — gap 4
questions.explanation: For weeks before she … — тривала дія до іншої минулої: Past Perfect Continuous.

questions.title: The Mystery of the Painted Door — gap 5
questions.explanation: Сталий вираз work up the courage, одна завершена дія — Past Simple.
